params.name: metrics
params.description:
Comma-separated list of metrics to return for the dashboard. E.g. `?metrics=READ_BYTES,WRITE_COUNT`.
Additionally, following operations are supported for metrics: [+, -, *].
Useful to aggregate over a "custom/fake" metric value (sum / diff / product of real metrics).
E.g. `?metrics=READ_BYTES+WRITE_BYTES,READ_COUNT-WRITE_COUNT`.
Which means take a sum of READ_BYTES and WRITE_BYTES, take a diff between READ_COUNT and WRITE_COUNT.

params.name: topn_by
params.description:
What metric to do top N by. By default, sum of all the `?metrics` is taken.
Only applicable if sampling and/or sub-grouping is requested.

params.name: aggregate_function
params.description: Function to use when aggregating the results.

params.name: filters
params.description:
URL-encoded JSON-string - actually an encoded mapping. Keys are column names.
E.g. `{"creation_time": [{"gt": "1727863200000"}, {"lt": "1729591200000"}],
       "atime": [{"gt": "1727776800000", "lt": "1729591200000"}]}'`.
Elements within a list per column are OR'ed, elements withing a map inside a list are AND'ed.

params.name: sample_per
params.description: Which column to sample per (X-axis).

params.name: sub_group_by
params.description: Which column to split the returning samples by (Y-axis).

params.name: samples_count
params.description:
Limit output amount of samples. Rest will be put into `"__others__"`.
When sampling per time, affects granularity with which samples are collected.

params.name: sub_groups_count
params.description: Limit output amount of sub-groups. Rest will be put into `"__others__"`.
